services.name: Private ride
services.story: The main story: Alex's private ride from home to the airport, Thu Oct 22, pickup at 8:00am for an 11:30am flight. $75 for the van, paid in full when booking. Hector drives.

services.name: Private ride
services.story: A regular rider's standing order: the same airport ride every Monday at 8:00am. A card is saved, and each ride is charged when Hector texts DONE.

services.name: Private ride

services.name: Group van
services.story: A group van for 12 riders, priced by Sam after the trip details are read: $640. A card is saved, and it's charged when the ride is done.

questions_before_times: Where the pickup is (a home, a hotel, an office or the airport) and the town
Which airport and terminal, and whether the ride is to the airport or from it
The flight time (it sets the pickup time), and for a ride from the airport, the flight number
How many riders and how many bags
Any children riding, in age groups (under 4, 4 to 7, 8 and up), for the right child seat
One way or round trip, and the time for the return
safety_stop: someone hurt or ill right now
a crash or a danger on the road
a threat to a driver or a rider
license: Where the state's rules or the local for-hire authority require it: a passenger carrier permit for the company, with each vehicle inspected and listed. Where the airport's rules require it, a ground-transport permit to pick up and drop off there. Elsewhere, the business registration.
staff_skills: ["Private and shared rides in a car or van","The accessible van (securement training)","Group van (a larger vehicle, with the license it needs)","Child seats fitted correctly"]
messages_never: ["The street address with the flight number, together","Gate and building codes","The names of the children riding"]
